exams.title: Building Regulations
exams.subtitle: Eight Building Regulations practice mocks
exams.description: Eight Building Regulations practice mocks covering approved documents, Part P notification, dwelling scope, certification, ventilation, fire safety and practical compliance decisions.
exams.format: Eight rotating 20-question practice mocks. Exam format: 40 minutes, open book. Pass at 60%+.

scoring.label: Strong — ready for Part P mock exam conditions
Pass — review missed source questions before moving on
Near miss — revise Part P scope and Approved Documents
Major gaps — rebuild Building Regulations fundamentals first

priorities: Notifiable work, special locations and the post-2013 Part P categories.
Approved Documents that affect electrical work: A, B, C, E, F, L, M, P and related duties.
Compliance routes through CPS notification, Building Control and correct certification.
Domestic scope: dwellings, gardens, outbuildings and common parts of residential buildings.
Read the wording carefully; the source tests use close distractors and regulatory exceptions.

exams.title: Wiring Regulations (18th Edition)
exams.subtitle: Twenty-two Wiring Regulations practice mocks
exams.description: Twenty-two Wiring Regulations practice mocks covering BS 7671 scope, definitions, protection, selection and erection, inspection and testing, special locations and appendices.
exams.format: Twenty-two rotating 56-60-question practice mocks. Exam format: 120 minutes, open book. Pass at 60%+.

scoring.label: Strong — exam-ready on BS 7671 mocks
Pass — review the missed clauses and tables
Near miss — practise navigation through BS 7671
Major gaps — rebuild 18th Edition structure and lookup skills

priorities: BS 7671 scope, exclusions, definitions and the seven-part structure.
Protection for safety: ADS, RCDs, SPDs, overcurrent, thermal effects and isolation.
Selection and erection: wiring systems, current-carrying capacity, voltage drop and appendices.
Inspection, testing, certification and special installations or locations.
Use regulation-book logic; these mocks test close wording and table lookup judgement.

exams.title: Fundamental Inspection and Testing
exams.subtitle: Two Fundamental Inspection and Testing practice papers
exams.description: Two Fundamental Inspection and Testing practice papers covering safe isolation, inspection, dead and live testing, commissioning, certification and core installation knowledge.
exams.format: Two rotating papers: one 30-question focused mock and one 40-question homework paper • 60 minutes • Open book (IET Guidance Note 3) • Pass at 60%+.

scoring.label: Strong exam readiness
Nominal pass standard
Keep revising

priorities: Follow the safe-isolation sequence exactly.
Know the order and purpose of pre-energised and energised tests.
Choose the correct certificate and supporting schedules.

exams.title: Portable Appliance Testing
exams.subtitle: Five Portable Appliance Testing practice mocks
exams.description: Five Portable Appliance Testing practice mocks covering equipment classes, visual inspection, combined testing, detachable leads, records, limits and practical judgement.
exams.format: Five rotating practice mocks: three 50-question tests, one 30-question test and one 35-question homework paper. Exam format: 80 minutes, open book. Pass at 80%+.

scoring.label: Strong — exam-ready for PAT mocks
Pass — tighten any missed inspection or limit questions
Near miss — revise Code of Practice fundamentals
Major gaps — rebuild appliance classes, tests and records first

priorities: Equipment classes, protective conductors, insulation and appliance construction.
Formal visual inspection, combined inspection and test, and when each is appropriate.
Earth continuity, insulation resistance, leakage and functional checks.
Detachable leads, surge-protected equipment, extension leads and practical limits.
Record keeping, retest intervals and duty-holder responsibilities.

exams.title: Periodic Inspection and Testing (Condition Reporting)
exams.subtitle: Six Periodic Inspection and Condition Reporting practice tests
exams.description: Six Periodic Inspection and Condition Reporting practice tests covering GN3 intervals, sampling, limitations, testing, EICR documentation, classification and defensible technical decisions.
exams.format: Six rotating practice tests: five 40-question tests and one 23-question homework paper. Exam format: 60 minutes, open book (IET Guidance Note 3). Pass at 75%+.

scoring.label: Strong - exam-ready on GN3, EICR coding and defensible reporting
Pass - review missed interval, sampling, limitation or coding decisions
Needs targeted revision - re-read GN3 Chapter 3, BS 7671 Part 6 and BPG4
Major gaps - rebuild periodic inspection and condition reporting fundamentals first

priorities: C1, C2, C3 and FI must be applied from observed risk, not from how easy the remedial job looks.
Any C1, C2 or FI makes the EICR Unsatisfactory; C3 alone remains Satisfactory with improvement recommended.
Extent, sampling and limitations must be agreed, specific, recorded and revised when findings justify expansion.
Periodic inspection is judgement-led: select safe tests, justify live testing, and interpret readings against the existing installation condition.
Duty-holder and PRS duties matter: immediate danger notification, 28-day remedial rules, written confirmation and next-inspection recommendations.

exams.title: Initial Verification
exams.subtitle: Two Initial Verification practice papers
exams.description: Two Initial Verification practice papers covering safe isolation, inspection, pre-energised and energised testing, commissioning and certification for single- and three-phase installations.
exams.format: Two rotating papers: one 55-question focused mock and one 43-question homework paper • 90 minutes • Open book (IET Guidance Note 3) • Pass at 60%+.

scoring.label: Strong exam readiness
Pass standard
Keep revising

priorities: Follow safe isolation and the prescribed test sequence exactly.
Know the purpose, method and expected result of dead and live tests.
Complete the correct certificate and supporting schedules.

exams.title: AM2 / AM2E — Installation Electrician EPA
exams.subtitle: Two AM2 mock tests
exams.description: A comprehensive AM2 knowledge exam set with two full mocks covering safe isolation, statutory duties, installation practice, inspection and testing, fault diagnosis and commissioning judgement.

scoring.label: Strong — ready for AM2 knowledge-style questions
Pass — review the missed AM2 source questions
Near miss — revise safe isolation, testing and installation duties
Major gaps — rebuild practical-assessment fundamentals first

priorities: Safe isolation, proving dead, lock-off and statutory safety duties.
Installation standards, containment, conductor identification and protective devices.
Inspection, testing, commissioning and certification decisions.
Fault diagnosis and practical judgement under assessment-style wording.
Treat each answer as a site decision, not a memory shortcut.

exams.title: ECS Health & Safety
exams.subtitle: Twenty-seven ECS mock and topic tests
exams.description: A comprehensive ECS health and safety exam set covering the full ECS safety spread: electrotechnical safety, special site hazards, work equipment, working at height, fire, hygiene, PPE, accident reporting, manual handling, general health and safety and environmental practice.
exams.format: Twenty-seven rotating source tests: sixteen full ECS mocks plus eleven topic tests. The category pass threshold is set at 86%, matching the full ECS mock standard.

scoring.label: Strong — secure for ECS health and safety mocks
Pass — review missed safety topics before booking
Near miss — revise the weak safety areas
Major gaps — rebuild health and safety fundamentals first

priorities: Electrical safety, isolation, site rules and supervisor reporting.
Work at height, ladders, PPE, manual handling and work equipment.
Fire prevention, emergency action, hygiene, COSHH and environmental responsibilities.
Accident reporting, RIDDOR-style duties and general risk assessment.
Answer as a site safety decision; avoid shortcuts that sound convenient but unsafe.

exams.title: Inspection & Design 2396
exams.subtitle: Fourteen 2396 design mock tests
exams.description: A comprehensive 2396 design exam set covering maximum demand, cable calculations, earthing, protection, inspection, design documentation, special installations and test instruments.
exams.format: Fourteen rotating mocks: thirteen 30-question tests and one 18-question test-instruments mock. Pass at 60%+ across the category.

scoring.label: Strong — ready for 2396 design-style mocks
Pass — review missed calculation and design decisions
Near miss — revise design method and BS 7671 tables
Major gaps — rebuild design calculations and verification first

priorities: Design sequence: assessment of characteristics, maximum demand, cable sizing and voltage drop.
Protective devices, disconnection, earthing arrangements and fault-current calculations.
Inspection, testing, certification and instrument selection.
Special installations, environmental conditions and design documentation.
Work from the calculation method; many distractors are close numerical alternatives.

exams.title: Level 2 Electrical Installation
exams.subtitle: Five Level 2 mock tests
exams.description: A comprehensive Level 2 Electrical Installation exam set covering foundation electrical-science, installation technology, health and safety, cable systems, protection and practical knowledge questions.

scoring.label: Strong — ready for Level 2 mocks
Pass — review missed foundation topics
Near miss — revise electrical principles and installation basics
Major gaps — rebuild Level 2 fundamentals first

priorities: Basic electrical principles, units, simple formulae and circuit behaviour.
Installation methods, containment, cable selection and conductor identification.
Health and safety, tools, drawings and practical site knowledge.
Protection, earthing, bonding and inspection basics.
Use the source diagrams and images where they are provided.

exams.title: Level 3 Electrical Installation
exams.subtitle: Five Level 3 mock tests
exams.description: A comprehensive Level 3 Electrical Installation exam set covering higher-level electrical science, design, inspection, fault diagnosis, three-phase, machinery and installation-practice questions.

scoring.label: Strong — ready for Level 3 mocks
Pass — review missed advanced installation topics
Near miss — revise calculations, testing and design decisions
Major gaps — rebuild Level 3 principles first

priorities: Electrical principles, formulae, impedance, power and three-phase concepts.
Design decisions, protective devices, fault current and disconnection.
Inspection, testing, fault diagnosis and certification knowledge.
Rotating machines, control gear, data plates and practical installation details.
Use the source images for formula and equipment-identification questions.

exams.title: Special Locations
exams.subtitle: Special locations mock test
exams.description: A special locations exam covering BS 7671 Part 7 style questions on rooms containing baths or showers, medical locations, caravan parks, marinas, swimming pools, saunas and similar higher-risk installations.

scoring.label: Strong — secure on special-location source questions
Pass — review the missed Part 7 requirements
Near miss — revise special-location zones and protective measures
Major gaps — rebuild Part 7 fundamentals first

priorities: Bath and shower zones, socket restrictions, RCD protection and IP requirements.
Swimming pools, saunas, medical locations, caravan parks and marinas.
Special-location disconnection, supplementary bonding and equipment selection.
Exceptions and exact wording in BS 7671 Part 7.
Read for the false or exception-based option; the source questions use close distractors.
